# Silicon Edge Consulting

> Silicon Edge Consulting is a technology training provider delivering live, instructor-led training in Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Data Engineering, and Software Engineering.

> Job-ready, instructor-led training in AI, Cloud, DevOps, Data and Cybersecurity. Live cohorts, verified certificates, and a job board for graduates.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of programs, instructors, and outcomes.
- [Courses](/courses): Browse all live and self-paced training programs.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced tiers (Naira pricing).
- [For Businesses](/for-businesses): Team training and B2B enablement.
- [Certificates](/certificates): How verified certificates work and how to verify one.
- [Jobs](/jobs): Open roles for graduates and partners.
- [Learning Paths](/paths): Role-based sequences for Cloud, DevOps and Full-Stack careers.
- [Blog](/blog): Career guides on cloud, DevOps, AI and certifications.
- [About](/about): What Silicon Edge Consulting is and who it serves.
- [Contact](/contact): Course inquiries, corporate partnerships and admissions.
- [FAQ](/faq): Delivery format, certificates, payments and refunds.
- [Instructors](/instructors): Instructor profiles.
